# Stake BNB

> Stake BNB is a non-custodial interface for delegating BNB to a validator on BNB Smart Chain. Users connect their own wallet and sign every transaction. It is an independent tool, not an official BNB Chain site.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Native BNB staking runs on BNB Smart Chain; users delegate BNB to a validator.
- Delegating gives validator-specific stake credit tokens that represent the user's share, and rewards accrue to the stake.
- Validators charge a commission, and gas is paid in BNB.
- Undelegating starts an unbonding period of about 7 days before BNB can be claimed.
- Validator misbehaviour can lead to slashing that affects delegators; liquid staking alternatives exist with different trade-offs.

## Pages

- Stake BNB & learn: https://stake-bnb.github.io/
- Legal: https://stake-bnb.github.io/legal.html
